question: What happens when the inner source fills the system abundantly?
premises: The inner door can pour in a stream of water.
When filled by that inner stream, the system overflows.
The resulting streams flow in all directions.
inference: When filled from the inner source, consciousness overflows outward in streams facing all directions.
uncertainties: The compound tvantaḥdvāravāridhārasaṃpūritaṃ is read as tu + antaḥ-dvāra-vāri-dhārā-saṃpūritaṃ; internal sandhi is within the single token.
plain_english: But when it is filled with savor by a stream of water flowing through the inner door, then streams filled by that overflow in all directions.
